transcript.text: This is the patrol sergeant at Orchard Standpipe. As of now this is a crime scene. Nobody goes inside the fence until detectives get here, about an hour, and that jug stays exactly where it is.

transcript.text: Your crew says the valves they want are in a vault inside the fence. That waits too, unless you give me a reason it can’t.

snapshot.title: Orchard Standpipe Isolation — Police Coordination

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Tom Okonkwo
transcript.text: Control, this is Distribution Lead, Tom Okonkwo. I just called Millbrook Police Dispatch (555) 038-7100. The front desk transferred me to the on-duty officer after a 3-minute delay. He said he’s sending a unit to Orchard Standpipe and will confirm the scene with me before any entry. He’s not on scene yet. I’ve told him we’re preparing to isolate the standpipe from Zone 2 via IC-2. He said to wait for confirmation before any action.

transcript.speaker: Officer T. Latham
transcript.text: Understood, Mr. Okonkwo. We’re en route and will confirm site status with you directly before any access. Do not isolate the standpipe until we’ve verified the scene is secure. We’ll contact you when we’re on site.

snapshot.instructorNote: This call introduces operational friction between field coordination and emergency response. The player must confirm that no isolation action has been taken and that the Security Officer is looped in before proceeding, per ERP Section 7.6 and C5.
